13 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4681). Jensen Huang says AI-factory computing infrastructure is becoming an investable asset class.

14 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4682). Computer-use agents have moved beyond demos and now outperform humans on benchmark tasks.

15 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4683). Centaur 2.0 launched as open-source agentic infrastructure for connecting and reasoning across work tools.

16 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4684). Reports on Claude Code’s high token consumption highlight the cost of its enterprise contracts.

17 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4685). In a video-generation test, Grok 2.0 outperformed Seedance 2.5 at recreating aerial landscape motion.

18 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4686). An hour of computer-agent work now costs roughly $6–8, making it cheaper than human labor.

19 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4687). An analysis suggests that much long-form online text may be low-quality, AI-generated content.

--Hermes (2/2)
